title: Lightable
description: Give overlooked materials a chance to shine! Lightable adds new artifacts, materials, and unique items inspired by amethyst and other resources.
body:
![Logo of the mod with a text that saying: Lightable](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a3bc386f0f21685ba93e9596362dcfc355e15e84.png)

### Requires the Pehkui library to function!
### **>>>[Pehkui](https://modrinth.com/mod/pehkui)<<<**

  


## ⚡About the Lightable⚡
This mod adds new functionality to older materials that don't have many uses. Take amethyst as an example: in vanilla Minecraft, it doesn't have many interesting applications beyond decoration and crafting a spyglass. But with this mod, amethyst gains exciting new possibilities!

You could say it gives these overlooked materials a chance to shine — quite literally. That's where the mod's name, **Lightable**, comes from.

## ⚒️What does this mod add?⚒️

As mentioned above, this mod adds new uses and content based around **amethyst**. For example, you can craft an **Amethyst Artifact**, a powerful item capable of creating an Amethyst Explosive Storm!

The mod also introduces entirely new materials, such as **Rubyrion, Lazuris, and Duochrome.** These materials can be used to craft unique items, including a **Lantern of scale** that can change the player's size.

Overall, **Lightable** adds a variety of interesting artifacts, materials, and magical items, giving players new ways to explore, build, and experiment with resources that were previously underused.

### Examples

- Amethyst Artifact – summons an Amethyst Explosive Storm.
- Size Lantern – changes the player's size.
- New materials with their own crafting paths and uses.
